newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chubu Electric to issue tender to buy electricity.
newsitem.headline: Chubu Electric to issue tender to buy electricity.

text.p: Chubu Electric Power Co Inc said on Tuesday that it would issue a tender to purchase a total of around 400,000 kilowatts (kw) of electricity on a wholesale basis for fiscal 2003/04 and 2004/05.
Japan's wholesale electricity sector was liberalised just over a year ago to allow non-utilities to sell electricity on a wholesale basis to power companies.
During the current year to March 31, six power utilities issued purchase tenders for a total volume of 2.65 million kw.
Japan has 10 major power utility companies. --Tokyo Energy Desk +81-3-5473-3706
